items.text: यच्चन्द्रप्रभवं वराम्बरगतं यल्लिङ्गसंज्ञं जलं स प्राणस्तदधः स्थिरं च कमलं धत्ते मुखोर्ध्वं हृदि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: बद्ध्वा कुम्भकमात्मगाढरचितं तद्ब्रह्मनाडीगतं ह्यानेतुं वदने षडध्वगकला सैवंविधा सारणा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: घण्टाकोटिकपोलकोटरकुटीजिह्वाग्रमध्याश्रयाच्छङ्खिन्यागतराजदन्तविवरं प्रान्तोर्ध्ववक्त्रेण यत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सम्प्राप्तं हनुरन्ध्रमूलविधिना यच्चन्द्रतोयं मुखे तत्सर्वं रविकालरूपसदने रक्षेत्परा सारणा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नृत्यन्नित्योर्ध्वजिह्वो यदि पिबति पुमान्वक्त्रधारामृतौघं सुस्वादं शीतलाङ्गं दुरितभयहरं क्षुत्पिपासाविनाशि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पिण्डस्थैर्यं यदस्माद्भवति बत महामृत्युरोगा द्रवन्ते दौर्भाग्यं याति नाशं हरति विषजरां याति काले भ्रमित्वा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: जिह्वाग्रं त्वथ राजदन्तविवरं नीत्वा ततो घण्टिकां संस्थाप्य प्रतिजिह्वपर्व शशिनो मार्गे कलां च क्षिपेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एवंसारणिके पतन्ति च सुधाधाराः पुनः षण्मुखगान्धाराप्यथ तत्कलापमथनं नाडीमुखोज्जृम्भणम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्राणवातेन नीत्वोर्ध्वं कोटरे चन्द्रजां कलाम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: मन्थितां दिव्यजातां च तेन गान्धारकर्मणा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नासापश्चिममार्गवाहपवनात्प्राणे ऽतिदीर्घीकृते चन्द्राम्बु प्रतिसारणां सुकृतिनः प्राग्घण्टिकायाः पथः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सिञ्चन् कालविशालवह्निवशगं भूत्वा स नाडीशतं तत्कार्यं कुरुते पुनर्नवतनुं जीर्णद्रुमस्कन्धवत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्रोत्क्षिप्तं वृषणस्य गोलकयुगं मध्ये ध्वजं प्रोद्ध्वजं नित्योर्ध्वे बत शङ्खसारणविधौ वक्त्रं विधेयं निजम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सर्वस्थानशरीरबन्धनवशात्स्कन्धोद्धृतानां यथा नाडीनां मुखतः सुधानिधिजलं सिञ्चन्नधो गच्छति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: वृषणाकर्षणं कार्यमथवा शङ्खसारणा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: बोधनं चैव कुण्डल्यास्तिष्ठेच्चैवोत्कटासनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पश्चादासनशुद्धवातनिकरानादाय कण्ठव्रणात्संस्थाप्या रविमण्डले तु भुजगी सम्भूतनाडीत्रयात्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: देवी मध्यपथोदिता प्रकुरुते कम्पं ततो मूर्छनां दूरकर्षणदर्शनं श्रुतिगणांश्चान्या महासारणा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: द्वे ब्रह्मणी वेदितव्ये शब्दब्रह्म परं च तत् हृदये परमे धाम्नि मध्ये तु रविचन्द्रमाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नादं तु तं गृहीत्वा च चैतन्यं तत्र योजयेत् द्वे ब्रह्मणी वेदितव्ये शब्दब्रह्म परं च तत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: शब्दब्रह्मणि निष्णातः परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति अन्यत्सर्वं परित्यज्य शब्दब्रह्म सदाभ्यसेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: स्वसंवेद्यमसंवेद्यं शब्दब्रह्म द्विधा स्थितम् चिनोति प्रथमः शब्दश्चिञ्चिनोति द्वितीयकः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: विवरश्च तृतीयः स्याच् छङ्खशब्दश्चतुर्थकः पञ्चमो मेघनिर्घोषः षष्ठमेतदुदीरणम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सप्तमं कांस्यतालाख्यं मेघशब्दस्तथाष्टमम् नवमो ऽप्यग्निदाहश्च दशमो दुन्दुभिस्वनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अनाहतनिनादो ऽयं पवनान्तविनिर्गतः ध्वनितेन विना यस्तु नादश्चैवमपण्डितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: चिनोति रसमुद्धृत्य चिञ्चिनोति भगाश्रितम् विरसांशेन सम्प्राप्तं मेघशब्देन चाविशेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: मज्जां पतति निर्घोषः संस्थितोदधिभीषणः कांस्यताले नभःशब्दः प्राणमेघध्वनिः क्रमात्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: जीवश्चैवाग्निदाहः स्यान्मोक्षः समरसो भवेत् विशुद्धमित्थमात्मानं पश्येत चात्मनात्मनि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्रथमे जनवात्सल्यं द्वितीये रोगनाशनम् तृतीयेन कवित्वं च दूराकर्षं चतुर्थके
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पञ्चमे वाचि कामित्वं षष्ठे भूमिं परित्यजेत्सप्तमे दूरमालोक्य चाष्टमे वज्रवद्भवेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नवमे स्फुरते कायो दशमे सामरस्यकम् पृथ्वीमध्ये भवेत्पृथ्वी चापामापस्तथैव च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तेजोमध्ये भवेत्तेजो वायुर्वायौ प्रलीयते आकाशो लीयते सर्वः सतत्त्वः पिण्डसंग्रहः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अनाहतो दिवारात्रौ ध्वनते तु धनंजयः तत्रारूढो यदा योगी प्राप्नुयात्परमं पदम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).
